purpose: Production is the one place where a mistake is not free.

steps.condition: The full test suite exits zero on a clean checkout.
steps.refuses: A suite that was never run, or run only on the author's machine.

steps.condition: The new test is proven to fail without the fix.
steps.refuses: A test that is green because it looks at the wrong thing.

steps.condition: No credential appears in the change or its history.
steps.refuses: A key. If one is found, it is revoked, never hidden.

steps.condition: A one-command way back is written down and tested.
steps.refuses: A deploy whose undo is improvised under pressure.

steps.condition: A human with authority says go.
steps.refuses: An agent deciding on its own that shipping is fine.
